base_dir.description: The base directory from where stealth operates.

email_address.description: Email address to receive integrity scan reports.

mail_args.description: Arguments passed to the mailer program.

report_file.description: Name of the report file relative to BASE.

ssh_command.description: SSH command specification for connecting to the client.

check_suid_executable.description: If true, defines FINDARGS for SUID/SGID executable checks.

checks.description: List of integrity checks to perform. Items is a flat map of check attributes. Type can be 'remote', 'remote_notest', 'local', 'local_notest', 'local_check', 'local_check_notest', 'get', 'get_notest', 'put', 'put_notest'. For CHECK/NOTEST CHECK types, log and path_offset are relevant. For GET/PUT, client_path/local_path/remote_path are relevant. For LOCAL/LOCAL NOTEST, only command is relevant. For CHECK/LOCAL CHECK, log, path_offset, and command are relevant. Label is optional text to prepend to output in report file.

daemon_mode.description: If true, enables daemon mode options in the second section.

uds_path.description: Unix Domain Socket path for daemon mode.

repeat_interval.description: Interval in seconds (or 'm' for minutes) between scans in daemon mode.

random_interval.description: Random interval to add to repeat interval in daemon mode.

log_file.description: File path to append log messages.

syslog.description: If true, writes messages to syslog.

syslog_facility.description: Syslog facility to use (e.g., DAEMON, LOCAL0).

syslog_priority.description: Syslog priority to use (e.g., NOTICE, INFO).

max_size.description: Maximum size for files retrieved by GET commands (e.g., 10M, 1G).

skip_files_list.description: List of absolute file paths to skip integrity monitoring.

skip_files_path.description: Path to the file containing the list of files to skip. If skip_files_list is populated, this must be set to the path where the list will be written/read.
